nuwa.name: Nuwa
nuwa.origin: ===Origins=== In the People's Republic of China, the government had developed a satellite relay network. The system operated in a very similar manner to the X-Men's mutant detection device, Cerebro. One of the scientific minds who helped to create the new Chinese mutant tracking network was Nuwa. However, Nuwa was herself a mutant, and she eventually decided to use her skills and abilities for the benefit of other Chinese mutants. So she turned rogue, helped to form 3Peace and would often come up against members of China Force; China's mutant powered police force. ===In Deep=== 3Peace met in secret, but were discovered by Snake, the field leader of China Force. Before the fight had a chance to begin, Snake was struck down by a mysterious stranger who revealed himself to be Reignfire. His offer was simple, in exchange for helping 3-Peace to gather information on the location of Chinese mutants, they would in turn help the Mutant Liberation Front. In their first mission together, Nuwa was teamed up with Feral. They were meant to enter a satellite tracking facility outside of Shanghai as stealthily as possible. However, Feral murdered the first two guards that they found. Nuwa was clearly unsettled by the swift barbaric approach, and therefore disabled the remaining facility staff using her own mutant powers to send them to sleep. The mission was personal to Nuwa, as they were going to use the same mutant tracking satellite relay network that she had created. On one hand, knowing the technology made it easier for her to create the software needed to hide their own mutagenic signatures from the tracking relay. On the other hand, the situation soon spiralled out of control. As well as Feral's unnecessary use of violence, China Force appeared. Although the Mutant Liberation Front and 3-Peace had China Force outnumbered, Reignfire sacrificed Rabbit as a demonstration of his power and to keep any dissidents in his team under control. Upon returning to the Mutant Liberation Front's base on the Ani-mator's island, Nuwa was clearly expressed her concern of deadly force. Although she stayed with the other members of 3-Peace to set her mind at rest, Moonstar observed at how they were idealistic to the point that they were oblivious to the danger they had put themselves in. Despite the deadly approach to the first mission, Nuwa had successfully achieved what was needed: the information gathered from the satellite relay was used to locate the so-called Citizen's Rehabilitation Centre near Shanghai. Despite the name, it was clearly a prison for Chinese citizens who had developed the mutant gene in their DNA. The two groups continued to enter prison with ease and eventually they reached the higher security areas which were meant to hold the prisoners. However, it was a trap; instead of imprisoned Chinese mutants, the remaining three members China Force were waiting with a heavily armed guard. Reignfire had betrayed 3-Peace and Nuwa realised quickly that they had been used to help Reignfire barter his terms with the government. Using her power to send the guards to sleep, 3-Peace made their escape. Although they faced Feral and Dani Moonstar outside the complex, Feral was soon sent to sleep, and Moonstar let them go. 3-Peace eventually disbanded and the three members went their own different ways. ===Manifest Destiny=== Nuwa had not been seen until she randomly turned up in San Francisco, still wearing her 3-Peace uniform. There she accidentally interrupted Boom-Boom's shopping spree. For some unknown reason she had terrorised the local stores and begun to use her powers to take clothes without paying for them. Nuwa had the element of surprise over Boom-Boom, and defeated her with ease by sending her to sleep. Unlike her previous encounter with the Mutant Liberation Front, Nuwa was no longer vocal or conscientious. As she sent Boom-Boom to sleep, the only thing she had to say was her own name. To Boom-Boom this was a puzzle, and she couldn't understand what the cryptic clue 'Nuwa' meant. It was only with some inspiration from Beast that she did some research on the internet. She searched on various different spellings to find Nuwa, and eventually found her FaceSpace profile page. There Boom-Boom could see that Nuwa had more 'friends' on line, and was able to study what her mutant abilities were. Being prepared, Boom-Boom went out to search for Nuwa again. In a display of over-confidence, Nuwa attempted to send Boom-Boom to sleep for a second time, and was fooled into thinking she had. However, Boom-Boom had dozed herself with copious amounts of coffee, so all the caffeine would keep her awake. Thus enabling her to stay alert and able to time-bomb Nuwa. Nuwa has not been seen since. It has not been revealed what has caused such a drastic change in personality or morality.
abilities: Charles Xavier.
weaknesses: Her powers do not work against people who have ingested sufficient quantities of stimulants, such as caffeine.

nyglar.name: Nyglar
nyglar.origin: Nyglar was Blastaar's wife and presumably the mother of his son Burstarr. She was one of the few people to survive a revolution led by Blastaar's father, Grondaar. Their son, Burstaar was taken into hiding and raised away from them to avoid him getting killed. Blastaar then reclaimed the throne. When Blastaar came up with a plan to defeat his rival, Annihilus, she initially agreed. She pretended to have been captured and the planet set up a ruse that Blastaar was still in exile and that he never returned. Blastaar then journeyed to Annihilus' kingdom, where he begged Annihilus to help him reclaim his throne and pledged that his people would serve him. Annihilus agreed and, meanwhile, a fake slave trader sold Nyglar to Annihilus. Blastaar then freed her and convinced Annihilus that Blastaar's people really had overthrown him. However, she soon began to see that Blastaar had grown more and more violent and realize that it was no longer an act, so she contacted the Avengers in order to get them to save the Negative Zone from total war. Meanwhile, she overheard Annihilus' plans to betray Blastaar and destroy Baluur. She attempted to tell Blastaar, but Annihilus killed her before she could and revealed that she was the one who called the Avengers. In order to keep up his ruse, however, Blastaar pretended to be unaffected by her death and agreed she was a traitor. When the Annihilation Wave reached Baluur, Blastaar's army arrived and destroy Annihilus' fleet, though he managed to escape. This battle led to the people overthrowing Blastaar again for his endangerment of lives just to beat Annihilus.

nygorn.name: Nygorn
nygorn.origin: thumb|left|156px|Original appearance. The Monitors were Ingesteev, Kordazt, and Nygorn, three members of the Marvanite race. Hailing from the planet Marvan, they came from a society that had reach the pinnacle of perfection. With no further drive to improve themselves, the Monitors were formed and sent out into the cosmos to find inhabited worlds and determine if they were worthy of continued existence. To assist them on this mission they also included three humanoid robots named Kallara, Milandra, and Askare who helped operate their testing devices. Over the centuries the Monitors found no world that fit their rigid ideas of perfection and they were destroyed. However, with each planet they eliminated, their three robots grew to have emotions and became horrified by what they were charged to do. Ultimately, they reached the planet Earth and here Kallara and her fellow robots enlisted the aid of the novice hero Nova and the Fantastic Four's Thing to try and stop the Monitors. During the ensuing battle, Ingesteev and Kordazt were slain fighting the heroes. With their mission aborted, Nygorn was offered an ultimatum from his former slaves: return with them to Marvan to convince their ruler, King Suzerain the errors of his way. Not wishing to do battle with his foes, Nygorn conceded and left with the three female robots. He was captured by the enigmatic alien, the Stranger, and was imprisoned in the Stranger's Laboratory World for the alien to study him. He remained there until freed by Overmind who launched an assault on the Stranger. He gladly joined the Overmind's forces until he was defeated by the heroes Hyperion and Doctor Spectrum. Escaping captivity again, Nygorn joined up with the space pirates known as the Starblasters, whose leader Skeletron was seeking to obtain the powerful Star Brand. Nygorn was sent to Earth's moon where he captured Uatu the Watcher to learn the location of the Star Brand. This allowed them to learn that it was in the possession of Kayla Ballantine, then girlfriend of the hero known as Quasar. Kayla's subsequent capture led to Quasar gathering a group of heroes to rescue her. Meanwhile, Skeletron and his crew sought the world where the Starbrand originated from. Skeletron eventually allied with the Stranger to probe the secrets of that world, Nygorn apparently no longer holding any animosity toward the cosmic being following his past imprisonment. When the heroes finally caught up with Skeletron, Nygorn and the rest of the Starblasters fended off against the heroes. When it was determined that Quasar had gotten into the ship, Nygorn quickly dispatched their foes and returned to the ship with the rest of the Starblasters, just in time for the Stranger to unlock the power of the Star Brand. Nygorn was present in the subsequent battle to regain the Star Brand. but ultimately Skeletron and his forces were defeated. Nygorn and the Starblasters were soon captured by the Galactic Council who later imprisoned them on Earth when that planet was deemed to be a maximum security prison for the universe's undesirables. Placed in Russia, Nygorn and his allies battled against Winter Guard. Ultimately, Earth's heroes forced the Council to repeal their decision, leading to all the alien criminals being removed from Earth. Nygorn's subsequent activities are unknown.

nyssa damaskinos.name: Nyssa Damaskinos
nyssa damaskinos.origin: Nyssa was a pureblood vampire living in Prague in the early 21st century. She was the daughter of vampire overlord Eli Damaskinos and the sister of Jared Nomak. In 2002, Nyssa and her partner Asad enlisted the aid of their most feared enemy, the Daywalker, Blade, in order to stop an even more powerful threat - the Reapers. Nyssa worked alongside a team of highly trained vampire agents, the Bloodpack, and was present when the Bloodpack raided the House of Pain looking for Reapers. After the mission, Nyssa discovered that the progenitor of the Reaper Strain was her own brother, Jared Nomak. Nomak bit Nyssa, infecting her with the Reaper Virus. Before she could succumb to its effects, she asked Blade to take her to the roof of her father's building so that she could see the sunrise. As the sun came up over the horizon, Nyssa turned to ash and died in Blade's arms. It was shown that Nyssa had mutual feelings for Blade, and Blade himself was visibly affected when she died. left|270px|Nyssa dead
abilities: Nyssa is highly proficient in and is capable of dual-wielding a pair of wakizashi swords.
weapons: Paired wakizashis. Paired pistols. Sub-machine gun.

o z chase.name: O.Z. Chase
o z chase.origin: O.Z. Chase was a bounty hunter who was hired to bring in the mutant superheroine Dazzler, not knowing that he was hired by the villain Dust. Eventually he realized he was in the wrong to be working with Dust, and helped defeat him and his partner Silence. Chase was present when Dazzler was abducted by the alien Beyonder, who was trying to understand humanity and thought he could make Dazzler fall in love with him. After Dazzler joined the X-Men, she and her teammates were presumed dead, Chase drowned his sorrows in a bar and read a letter from Dazzler recalling an adventure he and she shared with her fellow X-Man Wolverine and Chase's dog Cerberus. When a man in the bar disparaged the X-Men and Dazzler, Chase threatened him and made he and the rest of the bar's patrons toast Dazzler and the X-Men's memory.
abilities: Chase was trained in the use of firearms and in hand-to-hand combat. He was also skilled in tracking people.
weapons: O.Z. Chase customarily carries a shotgun.

oak dark harvest.name: Oak (Dark Harvest)
oak dark harvest.origin: Oak was a member of the Dark Harvest, a secret and deadly sect of the Priests of Pama, who were empowered with plant-based abilities by the Cotati. In the wake of the Cotati's invasion of Earth, the Priests of Pama detected the arrival on the planet of Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm and N'Kalla Masters-Grimm, two child soldiers of the Kree and the Skrulls, respectively, who were imbued with the chronoicles of each side of the Kree/Skrull War. At the time, the two kids were also under the protection of Franklin and Valeria Richards of the Fantastic Four. The Dark Harvest tracked down Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm and N'Kalla Masters-Grimm to the front steps of the 4 Yancy Street, where they combated three alies of the Fantastic Four, Spider-Man, Wolverine and Sky. During the battle, Oak overpowered and almost killed Spider-Man until Master Forest tasked him with breaking into the Fantastic Four's quarters. Having secured Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm, the Dark Harvest was driven away when Franklin and Valeria used image inducers to impersonate Ghost Rider and the Hulk. The Dark Harvest then raided an Alchemax facility to steal a neutronic wave front inducer. With it, they built an Omni-Wave Projector and forced Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm to beam memories of his people's conflict with the Skrulls into the mind of every Kree. N'Kalla Masters-Grimm tracked down Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm and attempted to free him, but was captured and paired with him to also inflict every Skrull with a similar psychic intrusion. The resulting mental attack awakened the buried enmity between the Kree and the Skrull, risking to break apart their Alliance during their war against the Cotati. Franklin, Valeria, Spider-Man and Wolverine tracked down N'Kalla Masters-Grimm in turn and confronted the Dark Harvest. Valeria and Franklin managed to make Jo-Venn Masters-Grimm and N'Kalla Masters-Grimm focus on their shared bond, changing the Omni-Wave Projector's beam into one which fueled the Alliance's bond. As soon as he noticed the Dark Harvest's failure, Lord Quoi of the Cotati turned their plant powers against them, turning them into trees.

oak warpie.name: Oak (Warpie)
oak warpie.origin: Oak was a Warpie - one of the children given superhuman powers by the reality-warping event known as the Jaspers Warp. When Nigel Orpington-Smythe, then calling himself Peter, subverted the government agency R.C.X., he used the Warpies as his own private army. When he ordered the Warpies to bring in the superhero team Excalibur, Oak took part in the capture of Kylun. When Kylun was distracted by the fact that his mystical swords had no effect on Oak's teammate Ocelot (therefore meaning that the Warpies were not evil), Oak knocked him out with a punch. Later, when Excalibur attempted to escape from R.C.X.'s Cloud Nine facility, Oak was one of the many Warpies who fought them. Oak battled Captain Britain, whose powers were not fully functioning at the time. Oak pummelled the hero, but when Peter was encouraging Oak to deliver a killing blow, Oak rebelled against him, refusing to do so.
powers: Currently none, all of the Warpies were depowered by Captain Britain on Otherworld using the Sword of Might. {{Navigation
abilities: Oak was skilled in hand-to-hand combat.

obax majid.first_appearance: Silver Sable and the Wild Pack Vol 1 16
obax majid.origin: Obax Majid was a mutant born and raised in Somalia. Having developed her powers, she allied herself with other Somali mutants - a rebel group called the Bio-Genes led by emotion-manipulator Leecher. After Somalia was devastated by a civil war, Leecher encouraged the Bio-Genes to expel the foreign presence from Somali territory so as to take control of the government themselves; Leecher manipulated the Bio-Genes' emotions so that believed that a peaceful solution was impossible. Leecher explained to Lightbright and the rest of the group that the American soldiers had evil intentions, and convinced the Bio-Genes to attack a Marine compound ten miles outside the Somali city Mogadishu, using their mutant powers to disable the Americans' technology. left|thumb|Meeting Battlestar The Wild Pack, a professional mercenary unit led by Silver Sable, had been hired by the U.S. administration to ensure that a shipment of food and medicine made it to its intended destination in Somalia. Pack member Raul Quentino picked up a signal from the marines asking for help, and the Pack (along with his superhuman division the Intruders) ran to the area as reinforcements, engaging to the Bio-Genes. Lightbright was able to see Intruders' Paladin in action, and found him a presumptuous braggart. During the battle, several combatants were affected by the goodwill wave of the Infinity Crusade, which encouraged them not to fight. The confrontation was however interrupted by forces of the terrorist organization Hydra led by Baron Strucker, who sought to conquer Somalia in the name of its southern warlords, among other goals. During the confrontation against Strucker, Wild Pack member Battlestar saved Lightbright's life by shielding her from a Hydra blast; Lightbright was surprised at the gesture, as she and the Bio-Genes had just tried to kill the Pack; but Battlestar convinced her to ally with him against Hydra. The Bio-Genes joined the Pack against Strucker, who was defeated but fled. Battlestar then invited Lightbright to go to the United States and join him in the Wild Pack. thumb|Travelling to New York in civilian clothes Lightbright did indeed travel to New York City and entered the Symkarian Embassy, the Wild Pack's base for operations on American soil, where she was received by the Wild Pack's administrative staff, Lorna Kleinfeldt and Mortimer; at the time, the Pack was on a mission involving a supernatural fog engulfing the city. Paladin was also at the embassy and tried to impress Lightbright, but she rebuffed him, which earned him the immediate sympathy of Kleinfeldt, who thought the same about Paladin. Despite this, Paladin pestered Lightbright until the Pack returned. Lightbright began a romantic relationship with Battlestar and the two went on a date together on Battlestar's night off. One of Battlestar's team partners, Doug Powell, seeing Lightbright elegantly dressed for the date, offered her his company before learning that Battlestar had beaten him to it. Powell was disappointed and spent his night off complaining that Lightbright deserved better than Battlestar to his friends, one of whom, Amy Chen, agreed that Lightbright was very attractive. ===Intruders=== thumb|left|In civilian clothes during a date with Battlestar Lightbright later joined the Intruders, whom she had already met in Mogadishu. The Intruders were led by former supervillain Sandman and included the mercenary Paladin, the bruiser Fin and the man-tiger hybrid Man-Eater, with Lightbright being their most recent addition. The Intruders' official base of operations was at the Embassy in New York City, but the Wild Pack had its headquarters in the European country Symkaria. Due to this, Lightbright spent extensive periods of time on Symkaria. Along with the Intruders and the Pack, Lightbright traveled to Beverly Hills to confront an alliance of street gangs secretly controlled by crimelord Justin Hammer. The confrontation was so brutal that Lightbright compared it to the open wars of his home country. During the battle, supervillains in battle armor joined the fight, several of whom (Boomerang, Cyclone and Spymaster) lusciously looked at Lightbright, upsetting her. Silver Sable discovered the secret lair of the criminal group Genesis Coalition and set out there in a Stealthcraft with her group from the Wild Pack; He ordered the Intruders to follow her immediately, but Sandman reported a problem with Man-Eater that caused a 47-minute delay. When they finally got underway, the Wild Pack informed them that there was a change in their mission due to discoveries made at the base, and the Intruders were to go to Bosnia, to confront members of the Coalition who were posing as Hydra agents. Lightbright was confused at this, and several Intruders believed that Sable was sacrificing her own life for the mission, but they obeyed the orders. Pack member Raul Quentino picked up a signal from the marines asking for help, and the Pack (along with his superhuman division the Intruders) ran to the area as reinforcements, engaging to the Bio-Genes. Lightbright was able to see Intruders' Paladin in action, and found him a presumptuous braggart. During the battle, several combatants were affected by the goodwill wave of the Infinity Crusade, which encouraged them not to fight. The confrontation was however interrupted by forces of the terrorist organization Hydra led by Baron Strucker, who sought to conquer Somalia in the name of its southern warlords, among other goals. During the confrontation against Strucker, Wild Pack member Battlestar saved Lightbright's life by shielding her from a Hydra blast; Lightbright was surprised at the gesture, as she and the Bio-Genes had just tried to kill the Pack; but Battlestar convinced her to ally with him against Hydra. The Bio-Genes joined the Pack against Strucker, who was defeated but fled. Battlestar then invited Lightbright to go to the United States and join him in the Wild Pack. thumb|Travelling to New York in civilian clothes Lightbright did indeed travel to New York City and entered the Symkarian Embassy, the Wild Pack's base for operations on American soil, where she was received by the Wild Pack's administrative staff, Lorna Kleinfeldt and Mortimer; at the time, the Pack was on a mission involving a supernatural fog engulfing the city. Paladin was also at the embassy and tried to impress Lightbright, but she rebuffed him, which earned him the immediate sympathy of Kleinfeldt, who thought the same about Paladin. Despite this, Paladin pestered Lightbright until the Pack returned. Lightbright began a romantic relationship with Battlestar and the two went on a date together on Battlestar's night off. One of Battlestar's team partners, Doug Powell, seeing Lightbright elegantly dressed for the date, offered her his company before learning that Battlestar had beaten him to it. Powell was disappointed and spent his night off complaining that Lightbright deserved better than Battlestar to his friends, one of whom, Amy Chen, agreed that Lightbright was very attractive. ===Intruders=== thumb|left|In civilian clothes during a date with Battlestar Lightbright later joined the Intruders, whom she had already met in Mogadishu. The Intruders were led by former supervillain Sandman and included the mercenary Paladin, the bruiser Fin and the man-tiger hybrid Man-Eater, with Lightbright being their most recent addition. The Intruders' official base of operations was at the Embassy in New York City, but the Wild Pack had its headquarters in the European country Symkaria. Due to this, Lightbright spent extensive periods of time on Symkaria. Along with the Intruders and the Pack, Lightbright traveled to Beverly Hills to confront an alliance of street gangs secretly controlled by crimelord Justin Hammer. The confrontation was so brutal that Lightbright compared it to the open wars of his home country. During the battle, supervillains in battle armor joined the fight, several of whom (Boomerang, Cyclone and Spymaster) lusciously looked at Lightbright, upsetting her. Silver Sable discovered the secret lair of the criminal group Genesis Coalition and set out there in a Stealthcraft with her group from the Wild Pack; He ordered the Intruders to follow her immediately, but Sandman reported a problem with Man-Eater that caused a 47-minute delay. fields.personality: Lightbright behaved in a classy, pacifist way, trying to avoid violent behavior, at least since she had left the Bio-Genes - before that, she was willing to kill her enemies. She disapproved sexist remarks, but sometimes was too naïve to identify those.
fields.notes: says that Lightbright served with the Intruders until Silver Sable decided to establish her headquarters in Symkaria. This happened in . However, Lightbright was still serving in the Intruders later in for the Antarctica mission. Possibly Civil War: Battle Damage Report is wrong.
fields.trivia: It is unclear whether Lightbright controls light and energy not generated by herself. Several people have mentioned that Lightbright is a very attractive woman, including Wild Pack members Battlestar, Doug Powell (although Powell was somewhat racist and Lightbright was a black woman), and Amy Chen (in the latter case, supporting the theory that Chen was homosexual). Lightbright had a criminal record in Somalia. This may had been due to her time with the Bio-Genes. Lightbright was never seen piloting a Stealthcraft, unlike many other members of the Pack and of the Intruders.

obb.name: Obb
obb.origin: Obb is an alien who work with Funtzel at Funtzel Intergalactic Towing & Recovery. For years, he has been in love with Orksa, Funtzel's sister and associate, looking on as she marries morons again and again. When Deadpool came up, confirming he had killed the previous husband, Macho Gomez, and wanted to marry Orksa, Obb decided to have him killed, using the argument of the last mission who ended in a fight with the Exto, in order to have the way clear to marry Orksa. He then call back Kak, commander of the Ongulian Defense Fleet, who was looking for a mercenary to help them destroy Id, the Selfish Moon who had destroy the Ongulian home-planet, and many others. Deadpool quickly accepted the mission, looking for consideration from the people, and left the station with the Ongulians. When Funtzel reconsider the status of Deadpool, considering he might be able to accomplish the mission, Obb feared for his plan and decide to go "help" him, following Orksa who had decided to go help her husband. He ended on U-235 and threatened Deadpool with a ray-gun but was quickly handed. Facing his coming death by Deadpool, Id or the planet explosion, Obb cried and reveal his love for Orksa, leading Wade to act as an heroes, removing his limb (with Obb's help), to be able to make both of them enter into the rocket prepared by Deadpool to escape, Obb's ship having become inaccessible after a seismic incident caused by Id. After the destruction of U-235 by Id, and Id's death, Orksa used her ship's tractor beam to recuperate both Wade and Obb (unbeknown to her, again) in the escape rocket, and send them back to Funtzel station. Seeing Wade unlimbed (in order to came enter with Obb in the rocket), Orksa violently react, revealing her attention to Obb. In the following days, they share love while Deadpool was in convalescence, and when he finally completely heal, he make them be officially together, considering his limb mutilation by Obb (on his order) was enough to be consider as he killed him, the necessary step to "space-divorce", and they had already kissed. Wade then quit, leaving Obb and Orksa married.

oberst von steibel.name: Oberst von Steibel
oberst von steibel.origin: Oberst von Steibel was a member of the Nazis and active during World War II. In the spring of 1943, he had Nazi scientists create a breed of dog that was equipped with poison glands in their mouth, making their bites lethal. He sent a pair of these dogs along with some Nazi soldiers to begin an invasion of the United States starting with an attack on Camp Lehigh. This operation was thwarted by Captain America and Bucky. Oberst von Steibel's subsequent activities are unknown.

obispo.name: Obispo
obispo.origin: Obispo was a member of the Ruling Council that governed over the Scadamite population in the alien planet Scadam. When the pirate armada known as Black Fleet approached the planet Scadam, ravaging other worlds on their path, the Ruling Council gathered in their chamber to discuss possible options. The Scadamites had several problems to present opposition: They have renounced to warfare generations ago, meaning that they had neither weapons nor soldiers to hold them. Besides, their culture had evolved to reject any aggression. The Ruling Council then concluded that their doom was inevitable. However, Council member Durgan the Philosopher dissented, insisting that they should at least try and fight. Obispo voiced the Council's mind: Durgan's word were heretic and he was to retract. Durgan refused to do so, insisting personally to Obispo. Durgan was then expelled from the chamber. The Council met again when the Black Fleet attacked a new planet, several parsecs nearer than the previous one. The greatest minds of Scadam tried to find a solution. Obispo explained that their position had not changed since the moment Durgan was expelled, also adding that Durgan had disappeared from sight probably abandoning them all. Durgan's pupil Tuskar, also present in the chamber, went after Durgan after this discourse. Eventually the Black Fleet attacked Scadam, starting a week-long battle during which Scadam was defended by Durgan and his agents and by visiting superhero Her. All of them failed to save the Scadamite population, which was almost exterminated, even if the Black Fleet was also destroyed. There were Scadamite survivors, it's unclear whether Obispo was amongst these or not.

obliterator alien.name: Obliterator (Alien)

This destructive juggernaut was unleashed on the planet of Z'lyztaya, where it slaughtered all the inhabitants, with the exception of Quinn, Yssa, their hatchling M'Rynda, and the navigator Zed, who were off planet. These survivors were tracked by the creature's ship to the planet Earth.

obliteron.name: Obliteron
obliteron.species: Celestial turned into a Dark Celestial by the Horde
obliteron.origin: Obliteron is a Celestial who may or may not have originated during the time of the First Cosmos; however, what is known is that Celestials' counterparts across the Multiverse are interconnected aspects of themselves and not separate beings. Thus, the Obliteron of Earth-616 is one aspect of the true Obliteron. ===Earth-616=== Obliteron was a member of the Final Host of Dark Celestials, a race of Celestials mutated and turned rabid by the Horde. After Loki unearthed Zgreb the Sorrower, he summoned the rest of his kind and facilitated their arrival to Earth in order to purge the planet. Before arriving on Earth, the Final Host infected and killed every Celestial in existence, and their bodies were hurled to Earth to herald their arrival. The Dark Celestial's arrival additionally resulted in the emergence of insects from the Horde that had laid dormant deep underneath Earth's surface. Some of Earth's heroes attempted to fend off the invaders to no avail. Captain America used Alpha Flight's Omega-Level Warp Grenades to teleport the Dark Celestials to the Sun in an an attempt to destroy them, but it failed. They returned to Earth and traveled to the North Pole, where Loki showed Captain America the corpse of the Progenitor, a Celestial infected by the Horde who had fallen on Earth four billion years into the past. In the meantime, the Dark Celestials started bringing about the Earth's end, causing the ocean to boil and setting the air on fire. The Ghost Rider tracked down the Dark Celestials. He rescued Captain America and abducted Loki, prompting the Dark Celestials to chase after them. All of the heroes convened in Sweden shortly afterwards. Black Panther and Captain Marvel charged themselves with the same energy as the Horde, which allowed them go toe-to-toe against the insects. She-Hulk and Thor harnessed the power of the Blood of Ymir they had retrieved from Asgard. Ghost Rider used his powers to take hold of a dead Celestial's armor. Finally, Iron Man suited up on the Godkiller Armor MK II. Despite their combined strength, the Avengers failed to overpower the Dark Celestials, and in the middle of the battle, the Horde revived the bodies of the Celestials they had infected and felled. After learning of the connection between the Progenitor's death, the Horde and the genetic makeup of humankind, Iron Man rallied the Avengers to join their energies to form a Uni-Mind, since he had been passed on the secrets on how to summon it by Ikaris while investigating the Dark Celestials' arrival. Using the Ghost Rider as a conduit for the Uni-Mind, the Avengers rendered the Horde dormant, reviving the zombified Celestials. The Avengers and the Celestials combined their forces and defeated the Dark Celestials. Afterwards, the Dark Celestials were restrained and teleported away from Earth by the Celestials.
powers: Celestial powers

obrien.name: Obrien
obrien.origin: Obrien was the last male of his line, descendant of the 19th century whaling ship captain who landed on the Chthonic Island and was sacrificed by the Broodlings of Chthon. He became the high priest to the Temple of Chthon at the center of the island. He greeted Carnage after he and Raze were brought to the temple by the other Broodlings. Carnage was to be sacrificed to bring Chthon to Earth, but Carnage escaped and killed many of the Broodlings. Carnage forced Obrien to hold the Darkhold while he performed the ritual to summon Chthon while using the blood of the Broodlings he killed as the sacrifice. Obrien and many other Broodlings were then killed when they were devoured by Chthon.
powers: Chthonic

obsidian mars.name: Obsidian Mars
obsidian mars.origin: Obsidian "Sid" Mars worked as a croupier in Dominic Fortune's Mississippi Queen. One night, she helped Tug Freeland steal Fortune's ship, by drugging him and claiming he had lost the ship to gambling. The day of the Annual Mississippi Queen 1937 gala charity, while Tug used a device to steal valuable data from the galas' attendees, Sid arranged their escape in a helicopter, and prepared an explosive charge to destroy the boat. When S.H.I.E.L.D. arrived to the scene, having helped Dominic Fortune recover his ship, Sid and Tug managed to slip away into the helicopter. However, Dominic discovered the explosive charge Sid had left, and threw it into their helicopter, causing the chopper to explode.

obsidian star.name: Obsidian Star
obsidian star.origin: The monster dubbed the Obsidian Star by the Beyond Corporation was a robot powered by an alien energy source. When it terrorized New York, Beyond operatives Misty Knight and Colleen Wing were sent to stop it. They attempted to trap the creature inside a Pocket Battlefield, but it reacted unexpectedly with Obsidian Star's energy source and merged the monster with a slasher film-themed haunted house simulation designed by Wing and trapped the two heroines inside. After battling the threats inside, Knight and Wing realized the monster's fusion with the setting and used an antimatter bomb to destroy it, shutting down the pocket battlefield which neutralized and returned Obsidian Star to normal. Afterward, Misty and Colleen retrieved Obsidian Star's power source from its remains and handed it over to Spectrum, later falsifying a mission debrief to Maxine Danger that they couldn't retrieve the monster's power source.

occultist.first_appearance: Spider-Man: The Root of all Annoyance Vol 1 1
occultist.origin: Occultist attempted to rob a bank using magic, initially creating a golem made of material from the bank itself to thwart the intervention of the Black Cat and then Spider-Man and then opening the safe transforming it into butterflies, but when he was about to use a spell to take the loot, he was interrupted by Spider-Man who was hit by the spell itself, and then knocked out with a simple punch. However, the spell partially worked, as the loot always returned to the possession of the person who had been hit by the spell, i.e. Spider-Man, who therefore was unable to get rid of the loot. To get rid of the spell, Spider-Man together with the Black Cat made Occultist escape trying to convince him to undo the spell, but once free Occultist cast another spell with which he created a golem made with the loot banknotes which clashed with Spider-Man and the Black Cat, but being the golem made of paper money he was easily defeated by Spider-Man who at the same time knocked out the Occultist again with a kick.

occulus.name: Occulus
occulus.origin: Occulus is an alien who lives on an unidentified world that exists in the Inniverse, a dimension that exists parallel to Earth's that is located by breaching the proper occupational frequency to allow passage between the distances between atoms and molecules that comprise of matter. An orphan, Occulus and his twin brother Wildblood lived on a world ruled by the Gem Guild, an upper class society that utilized "Gem-Talented" to utilize the power of gems that ring their planet. As it turned out Occulus was one such adept and incidentally the most powerful. While Occulus was personally tutored by the Gem Guild's Dangor, his brother was cast out and became a thief and rebel. Reaching the end of his studies, Occulus became the most powerful gem wielder of the realm. To cement his power, Occulus cut out his right eye and replaced it with a gem in which he could focus his power. After taking a wife named Landa, Occulus become a ruler of his world, he saved the people of their world but later became a tyrant. Wildblood meanwhile, became part of the resistance seeking to overthrow the rule of Occulus. During one of his wife's protests, Occulus used his power to sear off her left hand. thumb|left While on a mission to steal some gems, Wildblood witnessed as the hand belonging to the Fantastic Four' Mister Fantastic breached the barrier between worlds. When he was later found by the Gem Guild, he saw the hand pierce their realm again and used it to escape to Earth. There Wildblood battled it out with members of the Fantastic Four and was incapacitated. However, members of the Gem Guild followed Wildblood to Earth, and discovering that Mister Fantastic and the Invisible Woman's son Franklin was Gem-Talented, captured him, the Invisible Woman and Wildblood before returning to their own dimension. Wildblood, Sue, and Franklin were brought before Occulus and it was here that Dangor revealed to his leader that the Richards child was an even more powerful adept at commanding the power of the gems. Although Occulus saw the boy as a threat, Dangor convinced his master to use the boy as a matrix to utilize the power of all the gems on their world. As Sue and Wildblood escaped captivity, the matrix was constructed. Sue came back for her son alone, battling against Occulus and almost won had it not been for Dangor threatening to slit her child's throat. This allowed Occulus to defeat her and activate the machine. Ultimately, the rest of the Fantastic Four arrived with Wildblood and his rebels and attacked Occulus. During this battle, Mister Fantastic attempted to overload Occulus with his Gemenervator device, but Occulus managed to destroy it before it could finish it's task, gaining absolute power. Consumed with power, Occulus lashed out against his foes as well as his own people. This led to Landa betraying her husband to help the Fantastic Four defeat him. Utilizing the matrix device Occulus had created, Reed refitted it to emit a negative charge that send Occulus rapidly flying out of orbit and into space. Although Reed cautioned Wildblood that Occulus could soon return, although Wildbood assured the Fantastic Four that in the event Occulus did return, they would be ready for him. Sometime later, Occulus was pulled from the time stream by Aron the Rogue Watcher to defend a device that he was using to try and transform Earth's solar system into his own pocket universe. This plan was foiled by the Fantastic Four. Occulus and all the other time displaced villains gathered were then returned to their native realities. At some point, Occulus managed to enter Earth's reality where he stole the mechanical arms of Doctor Octopus. This "Doc Occulus" later battled the Human Torch and Spider-Man. Although the details of that battle are mostly unrevealed. Sometime after that Occulus was one of many Fantastic Four foes that were gathered by the Puppet Master and the Mad Thinker who were seeking to gather an army to destroy their mutual foes. However none of the gathered villains were uninterested in doing so and departed. They were unaware that they had left DNA samples which the two villains intended to use to control each attendee to use in attacks against their foes. These DNA samples were later recovered by the Fantastic Four and lead to believe that if they did not permanently contain their foes, they would be dead in two years. The group then began using the DNA samples to track and capture their foes. What they were unaware of was this was all part of a complex final scheme by the Mad Thinker, who wanted to pull off one more attempt to best the Fantastic Four before retiring into the Negative Zone with his lover Threska. Occulus was one of the many villains captured and contained in a new Vault prison the Fantastic Four had constructed in the Negative Zone. ocean.name: Ocean
ocean.origin: Ocean was a Mutant who went on the reality tv show to choose the line-up of O-Force. Ocean joined the team as its leader, helping rescue "kidnapped" celebrities (it was all staged) on their first mission. The team's second mission was to stop Arnold Lundberg. Overkill lead a press conference outside the town, which drew the attention of Arnie, who blew off Ocean's legs and raised an army of zombies. Overwhelmed, Overkill abandoned Ocean to the horde and fled. Ocean was rescued by Orphan and after Arnie was defeated he restored Ocean's legs as if they had never been removed.
powers: Ocean was able to transform her body entirely or partially into water. She could control the transformed parts, for example, water as powerful blasts, or use it to submerge and drown other people.
weaknesses: She nearly got killed when her legs got cut off. This seems to indicate her powers don't allow her to reform if injured.

oceanus eternal.name: Oceanus (Eternal)
oceanus eternal.origin: Oceanus, like every Eternal, was created by the Celestials one million years ago. 400,000 years later, a civil war erupted between two factions of the Eternals: the side of Kronos, who cherished peace and non-interference, and the side of Uranos, wanting to use their powers to dominate the planet. Oceanus joined Kronos' side and together they defeated Uranos and his followers, who were banished from the Earth. Still, some of the exiled Eternals met their doom in the colony of Titan and were resurrected on Earth, in the Exclusion, where they were mind-wiped. After that, they joined Oceanus, who had retired to a vigil of Deviants. Together, they became known as the Oceanic Watch.
powers: The Patriarchs are noted to be especially powerful, even among the Eternals. As a Patriarch, Oceanus can control the votes of his entire Dynasty during a Uni-Mind. However, in practice, he does not do this as he does not vote.

ocelot o force.origin: Ocelot was a Mutant who went on the reality tv show to choose the line-up of O-Force. Ocelot joined the team, helping rescue "kidnapped" celebrities (it was all staged) on their first mission. The team's second mission was to stop Arnold Lundberg. Overkill lead a press conference outside the town, which drew the attention of Arnie, who blew off Ocelot's teammate Ocean's legs and raised an army of zombies. Ocelot was seen injured after Arnie was defeated. Wanting to keep his fame as a superhero celebrity and not being able to find other gigs because of his apperance, years later, along with former O-Force members Orbit and Orifice, Ocelot joined the Upstarts, lead by Trevor Fitzroy, a team dedicated to hunt and kill mutants with newly awakened powers while live-streaming it on the internet. During an attempt to assassinate a mutant woman Jennifer Starkey, Ocelot and the Upstarts faced the X-Men; because they lost the fight, they had to retreat to their headquarter. When the X-Men retaliated sometimes later, Ocelot taunted Juggernaut and seriously injured Kid Omega during the fight; enraged, Marko broke the Ocelot's neck.

ocelot warpies.name: Ocelot (Warpies)
ocelot warpies.origin: The Warpie known as Ocelot was sent along with Lodestone and Oak to prevent the mutant known as Kylun from making contact with the public and arrest him. The public he was attempting to make contact with were his parents who lived in a remote part of Scotland. During the battle between Kylun and the three Warpies his enchanted blade passed through Ocelot's arm without harming him, proving that he was pure of heart. However, Oak took advantage of Kylun's momentary shock to render him unconscious before they transported him to Cloud Nine.

ocsh.name: Ocsh
ocsh.origin: Ocsh was a sentient spaceship encountered by Darkhawk. At one time he had been an alien humanoid scientist who had labored in the discovery of other dimensions. He was supposedly the one who discovered the dimension known as Null Space. He was part of Dargin Bokk's project to create a series of Darkhawk armors. When the scientists revolted against Bokk and took control of the armors Mandeja was killed by Bokk and Bokk later used her armor to blow a hole in their space ship. Bokk's host body was destroyed as were many of his cronies and he was stuck in the Evilhawk armor. Ocsh was trying to make repairs to his Darkhawk armor when he was caught in an explosion switching between his normal self and his Darkhawk body. As a result Osch's mind merged with the ship. The Darkhawk armors and their hosts were stored on Ocsh's ship in Null Space. Ocsh came to see himself as the caretaker for the Darkhawk armors as the Darkhawks and hosts were stored on his ship after they swapped places. After Portal killed Kistur, Kistur's body was stored on Ocsh's ship while the Mahari Brothers brought the Darkhawk body minus the amulet with them to every star system they went to. Two bodies were stored in Ocsh's ship that at that time did not belong to hosts, the Mahari Brothers merged Kistur's corpse with these 2 armors to create Overhawk. After Evilhawk's defeat his psyche was stuck on Ocsh's ship and he tried to recreate his Evilhawk body until he was defeated by Ocsh and Darkhawk but Ocsh did not survive. From this point on Ned Dobbs operated Ocsh's ship.

octavia otto.name: Octavia Otto
octavia otto.origin: Octavia was a member of the Young Avengers. One of her greatest foes was Spider-Woman. One day, an army of Electros broke into her home and threatened her parents, forcing Octavia to go with them. They took her captive and had her and the Doctors Octopi study the Web of Life and Destiny. Four months later, Spider-Man and Gwen Stacy freed the captive Octopi. Octavia escaped with her and she joined the Web-Warriors. Having discovered that someone on Earth-616 was using the Inheritors' cloning technology and fearing that they could use it to free themselves, the Web-Warriors went to Earth-616 to investigate. The person responsible was the Otto Octavius of that reality and Octavia seeing that he was her first counterpart interested in helping others, she wanted to try to reason with him. Octavia discovered that the Inheritors were indeed about to return, but she didn't have time to stop them. The Web-Warriors managed to escape their enemies but believed they had lost The Spider-Man and Stacy. Returning to the Loomworld, Otto declared that an army had to be assembled and the Inheritors killed. Octavia agreed with her counterpart and chose to join his group. Octavia checked out Otto's Spider-Bots and helped him find new recruits Octavia then convinced Otto to accept the help of the Scarlet Spider and along with the rest of the team, infiltrated their enemies' base to sabotage the cloning technology. When they were discovered they fled, having realized their plan. Octavia later learned of Solus' resurrection and the destruction of the Web of Life and Destiny and informed the team. During the Spider-Army's final battle against the Inheritors, Octavia was taken away by Otto who, with her help and that of the Scarlet Spider, found a way to transfer the consciousnesses of the Inheritors into newborn bodies, devoid of powers and memories.

octavia vermis.name: Octavia Vermis
octavia vermis.origin: The daughter of long-deceased Hydra Commander Otto Vermis, Octavia was experimented on throughout her life until she fought her way out of Hydra. Feeling betrayed by her father, she decided to create her own family and got Herbert Wyndham (the High Evolutionary) to create a clone who she could raise by herself. However, taking care of the baby girl, who she named Ophelia, soon proved to be a challenge, so Octavia kept killing her daughter and cloning her in the hopes of achieving a version she thought was perfect. After Wyndham warned her he wouldn't continue helping her in this endeavor, Octavia began looking for ways to do it by herself. This led her to meet her father's killer: Jessica Drew. At first, it was Jessica who came to her, when she tried to steal near-extinct spiders from her warehouse in the hopes of finding a cure for her disease, but the two met again when Octavia followed her to the laboratory of Miriam Drew, Jess's mother, in Wundagore, Transia. 200px|thumb|left|Human Form After a short siege of the facility, Octavia used the truth of Miriam being a clone to momentarily delay the Drews and take the research that could potentially help her with her plan, but on her attempted abduction of Rebecca, Miriam sacrificed herself to hold Octavia back, seemingly killing both in the blast of the facility's self destruct. In reality, Octavia survived and went back to Wyndham, who asked that she bring him Jessica, so he could cure her himself. After finding Jess, she promised to help her and went with her to several key locations to gather the data needed to devise the cure. Jess was then taken by Octavia to Wyndham's secret volcano lair, with an army of Miriam Drew clones as servants. As Wyndham readied a laser array to cure Jess's condition, Octavia copied his access codes and sent the clones into raging attacks. Now that she had all of Wyndham's technology for herself, she could finally live happily with her daughter without his interference and proceed to achieve perfection. When her daughter, who was actually fond of "uncle Herbert", turned against her, Octavia felt she had no choice but to kill her, hoping to clone her later once more. As Jess was accidentally punched into the array and cured, she turned against Octavia and the two fought, with a motivated Jess also punching Octavia into the array, just as Wyndham had finished programming it to mutate her into a dinosaur slave.

Now that she had all of Wyndham's technology for herself, she could finally live happily with her daughter without his interference and proceed to achieve perfection. When her daughter, who was actually fond of "uncle Herbert", turned against her, Octavia felt she had no choice but to kill her, hoping to clone her later once more. As Jess was accidentally punched into the array and cured, she turned against Octavia and the two fought, with a motivated Jess also punching Octavia into the array, just as Wyndham had finished programming it to mutate her into a dinosaur slave.

octavia vetivier.name: Octavia Vetivier
octavia vetivier.origin: Octavia Vetivier was an Italian socialite who attended the Chevalier Museum of Modern Art in Rome where she donated her expensive painting, the "Touramor" which was valued at forty million euros. The Invisible Woman was on assignment to keep an eye on her until she got the chance to further investigate. After creating the perfect distraction by using her abilities to make all the waiters drop their dishes on the ground, Susan grabbed Octavia and made the both of them invisible so she could seek her out of the galleria. Confronting her about Aidan Tintreach and her association with him, Octavia recognized Susan as the Invisible Woman from the Fantastic Four. She told her that she was innocent and that she was a scientist who made a breakthrough of a lifetime in communications. Her Li-Fi transmitter had the power to override and control any wi-fi device making it top notch technology which garnered the attention from the Moravians who kidnapped her husband Arthur and demanded that Octavia cooperate with them if she wanted her husband back. Susan thought that Octavia was a little sketchy so when she asked how long her and her husband had been together, Octavia replied for seven years but Susan noticed that she wasn't wearing a ring. All of a sudden one of Octavia's bodyguards hit Susan with a crochet but it ended up breaking as Susan erected a force field around herself protecting her from it. She dealt with the guards with ease but suddenly became sick after Octavia activated an infrasound device which affected Susan's anatomy. She then struck Susan to the ground as she explained that she wasn't even married, was the one who hired Enemy Argent and also had been working with the Moravians since the beginning. Susan asked Octavia why would she tell her this if she was just going to kill her but was interrupted by the arrival of the mysterious Aidan who was working with Octavia also. He then told Susan that she was going to help them.

octavian bloom.name: Octavian Bloom
octavian bloom.origin: Octavian Bloom was one of the heads of Hydra's activities in North America. Following the death of Daniel Whitehall, a representative of Baron von Strucker organized a competition between Bloom and three of Hydra's other heads. Whichever one of them could bring S.H.I.E.L.D. out of hiding would get to take Daniel Whitehall's now-vacant position. Before the competition could really begin, Sunil Bakshi escaped from S.H.I.E.L.D. custody and contacted Bloom. Bakshi convinced him to simply kill the other three heads, as well as the driver who drove him there. Although his operatives managed to eliminate his competition, the driver and his partner proved too much for them. They were really Lance Hunter and Agent Bobbi Morse, and in reality Bakshi's escape was a ruse concocted by S.H.I.E.L.D.'s director Phil Coulson to lead the organization to Hydra's leadership. Hunter and Morse broke into Bloom's house and killed him before taking Bakshi back into their custody.

octobliterator.name: Octobliterator
octobliterator.origin: Octobliterator was a giant monstruous octopod that attacked Times Square. It was confronted by the Avengers, and they were joined by G'illian Blax'zthor, a Skrull desertor impersonating Squirrel Girl. Due to Octoliberator's physique, which was adapted to sustain high pressure, the heroes were unsuccessful in hurting it. Captain Marvel eventually realized that Octoliberator wouldn't sustain dryness, and she had her fellow heroes attack her to absorb the energy of their attacks and go Binary, using the accumulated energy to release a massive energy blast that scorched Octoliberator, causing it to faint. When Octoliberator collapsed, it almost fell on top of a family of tourists. G'illian pushed them out of the way and let herself be crushed by Octoliberator, so that she could fake her death and make the Skrull Empire believe she had died on duty.

Unwilling to live a life as a slave to Dracula, she impaled herself on splintered wood.

of below.name: Of-Below
of below.origin: "Of-Below" was one of the archetypal beings from the Fourth Cosmos who formed the templates of heroes and villains seen in future iterations of the Multiverse, notably the Seventh/Eighth Cosmos. When the Fourth Cosmos was visited by the Defenders, he was seen fighting during the battle between the forces of Of-Past and Of-Future. He then joined with the other archetypes to fight Carlo Zota and What-Must-Be. Following the Fourth Cosmos' end, the archetypes joined with the Sentience of the Fourth Cosmos, later known as the Queen of Nevers, in exploring the Mystery.

officer gray.name: Officer Gray
officer gray.origin: Officer Gray was a member of the NYPD who went to assist two fellow officers caught in the middle of a fight between Vincent Doonan and Gwenpool in Times Square. Gray found Gwenpool taking cover and tried to arrest her, but Gwen convinced her to prioritize and focus on Doonan. Gwen also asked Gray for her name, so to elevate her from an extra and give her relevance in the story. After escaping from Times Square and while preparing to fight Teuthidans in Bay Ridge, Gwenpool contacted Officer Gray so the NYPD could evacuate the neighborhood. Once the aliens were defeated, Gwen called Gray to inform her that the police could come for the clean up. Some time later, Officer Gray was approached at her station by Ted and Martha Poole, who informed her they had received a call claiming Gwenpool was their daughter. Later Gwenpool was helping Officer Gray with paperwork, but abruptly left when she realized she was running out of pages.

officer krieger.name: Officer Krieger
officer krieger.origin: Krieger was a police officer who visited Dr. Karen Jenson in the case of her disappearance. In reality, he was a familiar sent by his vampire master Deacon Frost to kill her. Blade intervened and continued to beat him for information. From the tattoo on his neck, Blade identified Deacon Frost as his master. Blade then went to his police car and in the trunk were blood bags. Blade attempted to shoot him but, Dr. Jenson stopped him, and Krieger got away into a crowd. Blade and Dr. Jenson then staked out Krieger's car until he returned. They followed him to a safehouse where after a continuation of the beating he revealed the location of the Vampire archive. Krieger escaped to inform Deacon Frost who in turn killed him for his failure.

officer les.name: Officer Les
officer les.first_appearance: Immortal Hulk: The Threshing Place Vol 1 1
officer les.origin: Les was a police officer stationed in a town in Toews County. He helped cover up the operations of the Toews County Experimental Farm, which was using gamma radiation to grow crops. When a local girl named Rebecca Green wandered off into the farm, she got mutated into a disfigured monster which terrorized the town, killing three people over three days. When Bruce Banner traveled to this town to investigate Rebecca's disappearance, he found out the experimental farm. When he was being confronted by Rebecca's father Rick for snooping around, having also found him holding Rebecca's hair clip, the sheriff Darrell approached them together with Les. They arrested Banner, and Les guarded his cell afterward. Banner tried to convince Les to let him go to no avail, warning him about the monster which locals had previously spotted, as well as his eventual transformation into the Hulk. When the mutated Rebecca rampaged downtown, the commotion was heard from station, prompting Banner to transform into the Hulk. He broke out of his cell and grabbed Les, asking him how did he and the sheriff just happened to be nearby when Banner found the experimental farm. Les claimed that he didn't know, and the Hulk squished him until his head popped as punishment for lying.

officer ryan.name: Officer Ryan
officer ryan.origin: Officer Ryan was a member of the New York City Police Department in the 1940s. He frequently worked with Detective Mike Trapp whose specialty was solving murder mysteries. He aided Mike Trapp in some of his earliest chronicled cases including: Exposing Jeff Wolfgang as his uncle's killer, determining that disgruntled employee Mr. Casey was responsible for robbing the Smith Warehouse Office, that Peter Van Stone staged a kidnapping to ransom money from his rich uncle to pay his gambling debts, that a hotel bellhop murdered millionaire playboy Henry Richard, apprehend Charley Dine, and lastly apprehending gambler Lucky Adams. Following the Lucky Adams case, Officer Ryan no longer associated with Mike Trapp as he was seemingly replaced by crime scene photographer Pepper Burns. Officer Ryan's subsequent activities remain unrecorded.

officer stone.name: Officer Stone
officer stone.origin: Sammy Stone was a police officer operating in Los Angeles. She would frequently come to the Nickel Diner and chat with Frank Castle. Stone became disillusioned with the current justice system after her suspension for shooting a suspect fleeing a robbery, further exacerbated when Lou was assaulted by members of the Dos Soles Cartel. She decided to strike out and become a vigilante; however, she was caught and arrested while roughing up those who had beaten her friend. Escaping from prison with the help of Hector Del Sol, Stone became violent and insane, ultimately learning Frank Castle and the Punisher were one and the same. Vowing revenge on him for ruining her city, she confronted the Punisher in an alley, assuming the name Memento, and stabbing both him and his coyote, Loot, leaving them for dead.

ofira.name: Ofira
ofira.origin: During the Pre-Cataclysmic Age, circa 18,500 BCE, Ofira was a darkly beautiful enchantress who mastered the spell of metamorphosis, and was wife of Emandax, a dull-witted Red Slayer. They lived in the City of Wonders in Valusia, near King Kull's palace Ofira's husband introduced her to King Kull to help him solve the great calamity which was cursing the City of Wonders. Ofira, wishing to acquire the king's power, attempted to take him to herself, but Kull eventually rejected her. Ofira then incited Emandax to undermine to black legions within, while she plotted revenge aiding Emperor Varicus of Zarfhaana. Before the battle, she managed to turn Varicus' entire army into beast-like elk-men. During the battle, Sen-Dor, sorcerer of Kamelia, eventually transformed her into a harmless mouse, breaking her spell.
powers: Spell of metamorphosis: Ofira could turn a rooster it a lizard, (allegedly) turn a boy into a mouth, or the full of the Zarfhaanan army into anthropomorphic "elk-men".

ogar of the ocean.name: Ogar of the Ocean
ogar of the ocean.origin: Not much is known about the man who called himself Ogar of the Ocean. Active in the 1940s, he was obsessed with ruling the Earth's oceans. With his own submarine and drugs that could expand the size of single celled organisms into massive creatures. He saw his only obstacle in his way being the Sub-Mariner and sought to eliminate him. Incredibly enough, he managed to get the Nazis to help him in his plans. Issuing a challenge to Namor while he was staying at Palm Beach, Namor was led on a wild goose chase to a local beauty contest, and Daytona Beach where he fought Ogar's massive single celled creatures. Spotting Ogar's sub, Namor boarded it but was subdued by Ogar and his Nazi allies. While Ogar was distracted, Namor managed to knock over a vat of acid, compromising the integrity of the vessel. Namor escaped with Ogar and turned him over to the authorities. As Ogar was being led away by the authorities he vowed to get revenge against the Sub-Mariner, however Ogar has not been seen since.

ogeode.species: Human resurrectedCategory:Magic-Based Mutates as a Catbeast
ogeode.first_appearance: Saga of Crystar, Crystal Warrior Vol 1 1
ogeode.origin: ===Crystalium=== ... ===Weirdworld=== After the Crystal Kingdom was placed in Weirdworld, Ogeode reappeared there as a member of the Wilder Men, hiding into the Haunted Forest while studying new ways to do magic. Stranded on Weirdworld, teenager Becca Rodriguez encountered Ogeode, who proclaimed that he had caused her plane to crash with an artifact known as the Wuxian Seed; however, the wizard was then promptly killed by Goleta the Wizardslayer. Alone in Weirdworld, Becca agreed to become Goleta's squire, and the two set off together, unknowingly being tracked by the Catbeast, which had emerged resurrected from Ogeode's corpse. While travelling around Weirdworld and training Becca to be her squire, Goleta was startled by the sudden appearance of the Catbeast and unintentionally drove off the road. There the pair were attacked by Sand Sharks and Becca was forced to operate Glorianna in order to rescue Goleta from the creatures. Upon reaching safety, the Catbeast revealed his true identity, forcing Becca to step between him and Goleta's axe, lest he be killed again before he could send her back to Earth. Ogeode then explained that in order to do so he needed to travel across the Fang Mountains to retrieve a spare wizard body and offered to reveal the location of the Hidden Fortress of the Wilder Men in exchange for Goleta's help. The Wizardslayer agreed only to discover they could not yet set out on this new adventure as unfortunately due to her youth, Becca was not a very proficient driver and had burned out the Glorianna's Emerald Fuel Injector during the escape from the Endless Desert. The trio went to see Nakia the Grand Mechanic in order to barter for an Emerald Fuel Injector to repair the Glorianna, but she refused to help them because the Earthgirl's presence on Weirdworld unbalanced the fragile truce between the Swamp Queen Alliance and the Kingdom of the Torch. Having discovered Nakia spying on her, Witch Queen Le Fay unleashed the Mammoth Inferno who led an assault on the Forge of the Grand Mechanic. During the ensuing chaos, Becca sneaked off as Goleta and Ogeode watched the Giant Ghost Robot engage the Mammoth Inferno. Goleta then revealed that the reason she hated wizards was because she was from the Valley of the Burled Oak, a hamlet which was destroyed by the Wilder Men. Becca returned with a stolen Emerald Fuel Injector and the party fled to repair the Glorianna in order to continue with their quest. During the final fight against Morgan, on the Fang Mountains, Ogeode tried to escape with the Wuxian Seed, but Le Fay hit him with pure magic energy, causing the destruction of the Seed and the death of the Catbeast, who was buried on those Mountains. However, Ogeode came back to life through unknown means and met young Emily Bright, a student from Strange Academy. Ogeode appeared able to easily travel between Weirdworld and Earth and so he helped the girl coming back to the Academy , where the wizard decided to stay for a time, aiding Emily and the other students whenever necessary, such as when Weirdworld student Toth was misteriously shattered into pieces and Catbeast offered to cast the spell that would have rebuilt him.
powers: As the Catbeast, Ogeode possesses the ability to breathe fire. As the Catbeast, Ogeode possesses the ability to fly by means of his natural wings.

While travelling around Weirdworld and training Becca to be her squire, Goleta was startled by the sudden appearance of the Catbeast and unintentionally drove off the road. There the pair were attacked by Sand Sharks and Becca was forced to operate Glorianna in order to rescue Goleta from the creatures. Upon reaching safety, the Catbeast revealed his true identity, forcing Becca to step between him and Goleta's axe, lest he be killed again before he could send her back to Earth. Ogeode then explained that in order to do so he needed to travel across the Fang Mountains to retrieve a spare wizard body and offered to reveal the location of the Hidden Fortress of the Wilder Men in exchange for Goleta's help. The Wizardslayer agreed only to discover they could not yet set out on this new adventure as unfortunately due to her youth, Becca was not a very proficient driver and had burned out the Glorianna's Emerald Fuel Injector during the escape from the Endless Desert. The trio went to see Nakia the Grand Mechanic in order to barter for an Emerald Fuel Injector to repair the Glorianna, but she refused to help them because the Earthgirl's presence on Weirdworld unbalanced the fragile truce between the Swamp Queen Alliance and the Kingdom of the Torch. Having discovered Nakia spying on her, Witch Queen Le Fay unleashed the Mammoth Inferno who led an assault on the Forge of the Grand Mechanic. During the ensuing chaos, Becca sneaked off as Goleta and Ogeode watched the Giant Ghost Robot engage the Mammoth Inferno. Goleta then revealed that the reason she hated wizards was because she was from the Valley of the Burled Oak, a hamlet which was destroyed by the Wilder Men. Becca returned with a stolen Emerald Fuel Injector and the party fled to repair the Glorianna in order to continue with their quest. During the final fight against Morgan, on the Fang Mountains, Ogeode tried to escape with the Wuxian Seed, but Le Fay hit him with pure magic energy, causing the destruction of the Seed and the death of the Catbeast, who was buried on those Mountains. However, Ogeode came back to life through unknown means and met young Emily Bright, a student from Strange Academy. Ogeode appeared able to easily travel between Weirdworld and Earth and so he helped the girl coming back to the Academy , where the wizard decided to stay for a time, aiding Emily and the other students whenever necessary, such as when Weirdworld student Toth was misteriously shattered into pieces and Catbeast offered to cast the spell that would have rebuilt him.
powers: As the Catbeast, Ogeode possesses the ability to breathe fire. As the Catbeast, Ogeode possesses the ability to fly by means of his natural wings.

ogg.name: Ogg
ogg.origin: Sgt. Ogg was a member of an intergalactic police patrol tasked with pursuing a group of space pirates across the cosmos. The chase led his unit to Earth, where the criminals had arrived first and disguised themselves as friendly visitors to gain the planet’s protection. Upon arrival, Sgt. Ogg and his fellow officers encountered Earth’s military forces prepared for conflict. Following the intervention of Henry Mathews, communication was established, and the truth was revealed: the supposed refugees were in fact the criminals being pursued. Sgt. Ogg participated in the arrest of the space pirates, successfully concluding the mission.

oggmunder dragglevadd vinnsuvius xvii.name: Oggmunder Dragglevadd Vinnsuvius XVII
oggmunder dragglevadd vinnsuvius xvii.origin: ===Early Life=== Oggmunder Dragglevadd Vinnsuvius XVII, known as Oggy for short, was a Mountain Giant native to the Hills of Jotunheim, of the Longstomp Tribe. ===League of Realms=== He was sent as an emissary of the Mountain Giants to the . A master archer and warrior, Oggy was recruited to represent his people into the League of Realms, a team uniting warriors of the Nine Realms in order to hunt down Malekith the Accursed while he was slaughtering his people across the Nine Realms. That team was assembled as Thor desired to lead an army of Asgardians, but such action was considered an illegal incursion on the Realms. The League consisted of Sir Ivory Honeyshot of Alfheim, Ud the Troll, Lady Waziria of Svartalfheim and Screwbeard of Nidavellir. The League was first sent in Nidavellir to protect the Dark Elves' Queen in exile, Alflyse, but their inability to work together properly led to their inability to defend her. The League clashed with Malekith's forces multiple times, eventually managing to save refugees in Alfheim, slaughtering Dark Elves refugees, but once again Malekith slipped away. In order to prevent his League from falling apart in front of him, Thor had the group headed to the nearest tavern, where Thor and Ogg engaged in a drinking contest, while the others wagered on the winner, narrowly drinking the giant under the table. The next day, the League headed to Jotunheim where Malekith was hunting down a group of Elves who hided among the Mountain Giants. Oggy was directly targeted by the Accursed, who leaped into his mouth and brutally slashed apart the Giant's brain with his blades, felling him. Unable to avenge Oggy due to Malekith fleeing in Frost Giant territory, Thor buried his fallen comrade. His grave was marked of the epitaph "Here lies Oggmunder Dragglevladd Vinnsuvius XVII, Son of Jotunheim, Defender of Realms, A Giant of few words but mighty deeds".
powers: Being a giant he had great physical strength, he was seen to be able to easily punch though a cavern wall.
weapons: A bow, and arrows that fell like bombs.

ogor kallusian.name: Ogor (Kallusian)
ogor kallusian.origin: Ogor is the monarch ruler of the Kallusians, who guided them towards Earth, fleeing from an interplanetary war. When the Avengers broke into their underground city, he ordered to render them immobile, but with the hearing unimpaired, as he told them the history of his race. At first, he refused them to bring Doctor Svenson back to the surface, but, as soon as the Kallusians were discovered and had to leave the planet to engage their foes into outer space, he agreed to transport the Avengers and Doctor Svenson back to America through a matter displacer.

ogord.name: Ogord
ogord.origin: Ogord was a male member of the Arcturan race who was born on their homeworld, Arcturus IV, sometime in the 20th century. As was the custom among his people, Ogord was drafted into their military, the Reavers of Arcturus, when he came of age. At some point he married the woman Salaan and they had a daughter who they named Aleta. However, for reasons that have not been revealed, the couple were unable to have a son of their own. In the early 21st century, when Aleta was still a young girl, Ogord was part of a mission to exterminate the last of the "mutants" who inhabited the ruins of an ancient city. After parachuting down from a dirigible, Ogord entered an old laboratory and saw a female mutant holding an infant in her arms. As Ogord approached them, the female placed the infant on a table just before Ogord slew her. As Ogord prepared to use his blade to kill the infant as well, he mistook the seemingly-normal child for one of his own race and spared his life. Once all of the mutants had been killed, Ogord presented his find to his commander who agreed to let Ogord keep the infant because Ogord and his wife could have no son of their own. Ogord then brought the child home and introduced him to his new family. Ogord and Salaan named their new son "Stakar" and expected that he would grow up to become a strong warrior. However, Stakar proved to be a disappointment to Ogord because he preferred to spend his time thinking instead of training. Eventually, when Stakar was a young man about to face his First Contest, he chose to travel to the forbidden ruins and Aleta followed him. A week later, after learning that his children had gone missing, Ogord led a patrol to the ruins to find them. Aleta spotted them approaching and her fear of what he would do to them led her to do something rash that caused her to merge with the Hawk God which then burst out from the underground temple where it had stood for centuries. After the Hawk God reached the surface and began destroying the Arcturian air force, Stakar managed to initiate a merger with it that resulted in a multinuclear explosion and implosion. Investigating the smooth plain of fused glass that was left at ground zero, Ogord and his men discovered Stakar standing at the center. As Ogord demanded to know what was going on, Stakar suddenly transformed into Aleta and then transformed again into a blue-clad being who called himself Starhawk and claimed to be Stakar and Aleta. When Starhawk stated that he was the power that Arcturus had been, Ogord was delighted, believing that with that power the stars would be theirs for the taking, but Starhawk refused, stating that his power would never be used to conquer. As Starhawk flew away, Ogord shouted after him to come back and swore that, if he abandoned them, Ogord would never rest until he had his head. As the centuries passed, Ogord survived and rose in rank until he became the High Commander of the Reavers. In 3016 A.D., an elite Reaver starship stumbled upon Starhawk's asteroid lair and discovered the existence of his three children, Tara, Sita, and John. On Ogord's orders, the three children were brought to Arcturus IV where testing revealed that they possessed latent power of unusual strength and could become psychic vampires. Ogord used headbands that mentally controlled them to press his own grandchildren into imperial service so that they would kill Starhawk. In his headquarters on Arcturus IV, Ogord received reports about the ongoing action being taken against the starship Captain America that was carrying Starhawk and his allies, the Guardians of the Galaxy. While watching a video transmission showing Starhawk escaping from the force-globe in which the Captain America had been trapped, Ogord gloated to his grandchildren about how, after a millennium, he had at last lured his children home so that they could be killed. Later, as he watched Starhawk hurtling through the Arcturian system, Ogord decided the time had come to kill Starhawk's friends so he ordered the Arcturian Scout Ship Kammar to increase their disruptor output to the ultimate. The resulting protonucleic disruptor pulse struck the Captain America and destroyed it, reducing it to wreckage. However, the Guardians were able to survive in an escape module which they used to board the Kammar. They then easily subdued the entire crew and commandeered the vessel. Once Starhawk had reached Arcturus IV and blasted his way into Ogord's complex, Ogord confronted him, showed him the children and ordered them to attack. As Starhawk fell before the attack, Ogord stood over him and revealed that he had released the children's latent ability to feed on the life-forces of other beings. Ogord then commanded the entranced children to continue stealing away Starhawk's soul, and the children swiftly aged into adults as they absorbed Starhawk's life force. However, before the greatly-weakened Starhawk could be killed, the Guardians arrived and Ogord commanded the children
powers: As an Arcturan, Ogord had an extremely long lifespan and, although showing signs of age, was active as the leader of the Reavers of Arcturus when he was over one thousand years old.

ogre gang leader.name: Ogre (Gang Leader)
ogre gang leader.origin: The man known as the Ogre was a gang leader that was active in the Oregon area during the 1940s. Running his operation from an ore mine, he and his men targeted a train carrying gold bullion in 1945. To get at the gold, they blew up a rail bridge causing the train to crash to the bottom of a gorge, killing all aboard. They then stole the gold and fled on a motorboat, but abandoned it by escaping in a plane, leaving the boat to wreck itself to throw off anyone who might be on their trail. Unfortunately, their activities attracted the attention of the Human Torch and Toro who deduced the method of escape and tracked down their plane. After calling in the FBI, the two heroes were knocked out from behind by one of the Ogre's men. However the Ogre betrayed his minion by dumping him with Torch and Toro an ore grinder. The Torch, reviving first, flamed on and was only able to rescue Toro from death. The two flaming heroes then rounded up the Ogre and his remaining men and turned them over to the arriving police. The Ogre's subsequent fate is unknown.
